sources.supports: Minnesota Ojibwe context for the wolf as a companion whose fate is linked with people. The copper coat, poison and Kettlurk conflict are original game fiction.

sources.title: University of Minnesota mineral guide: Native Copper, page35
sources.supports: Rare native copper in Minnesota glacial drift; exposed metal weathers from rose/copper-red to brown or green. The giant living wolf is fiction.

native_revision_note: Float-copper revision replaces layered pointed fur with rounded mineral masses, broad green patina and copper high points. Preserve wolf ears, muzzle and grounded paws.

material_reference.role: Natural float copper material only; never shipped as creature art.

visual_review.notes: Inspected selected v4 source and native56 front/native48 close rear. The broad wolf muzzle, tall paired ears, four grounded wolf legs, enormous forepaws and thick tail remain readable. Rounded shoulder and chest masses replace pointed fur plates. Green patina covers broad surfaces; copper high spots and sparse white glints describe natural float copper. Close rear matches ears, muzzle, material masses and copper/green distribution. Four native GBC inks, continuous exterior silhouette, no dragon or feline anatomy. Earlier native variants remain in immutable versions.
